gaps.sentence: Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.

gaps.sentence: The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.

gaps.sentence: The company is famous for its ___ (INNOVATE) designs.
The model predicts the weather with remarkable ___ (ACCURATE).
